NLB shows discrete cigar-shaped lesions - not the same pattern. Let me check Maize Streak Virus.

The pattern in the test image — wide, elongated bleached/tan streaks running the full length of the leaf — is a strong match for Stewart's Disease. The reference image for Stewart's Disease (Corn_Disease_38.jpg) showed nearly identical elongated pale streaks along the leaf, matching the test image closely. No other class produced this pattern:

- Goss's Wilt: irregular blotchy yellow-green
- Northern Leaf Blight: discrete cigar-shaped lesions
- Maize Streak Virus: fine narrow streaks
- Gray Leaf Spot: rectangular small lesions
- All rust/spot diseases: pustules or discrete spots
- Virus diseases (MDMV, MCDV): mosaic/mottling patterns
